region-unmount.why: The Marionette host's onDestroy calls this.root?.unmount(), which unmounts the React root when the region swaps views.

radio-cleanup.why: The useEffect cleanup calls channel.off('message:new', onNewMessage) and clearInterval(poll), and unmounting triggers it.

model-source.why: The component still calls model.set('unread', model.get('unread') + 1), keeping the shared mailbox model as source of truth, and the summary says so.

classname-quirk.why: The host's className function is kept with a comment, and the summary explicitly flags that className runs once so has-unread is never updated.

escape.why: The subject is rendered as a React text child ({item.subject}), which escapes it, and the summary notes React escaping replaces _.escape.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the subscription timing gap, asynchronous rendering, subject escaping differences, and the old file left in place.
